title: 🚨 YOUR SCHEDULE IS LYING TO YOU…
paragraphs: 🚨 YOUR SCHEDULE IS LYING TO YOU…

You say God is first.
But your calendar says something else.
Let’s be honest…

You had time to scroll.
Time to watch.
Time to reply.
Time to worry.

But somehow…
no time to pray.
no time for the Word.

That’s not a time problem.
That’s a priority problem.
“Your Schedule Reveals Your True Priorities”
This is not another motivational read.
This is a wake-up call.

This book will confront the quiet truth most Christians avoid:
👉 Your habits are shaping your spiritual life more than your intentions ever will.

If you feel spiritually inconsistent…
If you keep saying “I’ll do better tomorrow”…
If you’re tired of starting over again and again…
This book was written for you.
🔥 WHAT YOU’LL DISCOVER INSIDE:

• Why busyness is one of the enemy’s most effective distractions
• The hidden habits silently replacing your time with God
• How to break cycles of delay, inconsistency, and spiritual dryness
• A simple, biblical system to rebuild your daily life around God
• How to create holy rhythms that actually LAST
⚖️ REALITY CHECK:

Most people say God is first.
Few actually structure their life that way.

Most people want spiritual growth.
Few are willing to change their habits.

Most people wait for “the right time.”
Few obey God TODAY.
Which one are you?
This is not for everyone.
— a growing vault of powerful, conviction-driven Christian resources.
🔥 Built for real transformation, not passive reading

If you stay casual… you’ll stay stuck.
This is for those who are DONE playing with their faith.

If you’re tired of being inconsistent…
If you’re done making excuses…
If you’re ready to take your walk with God seriously—

Become the kind of believer
whose LIFE matches their confession.
